KAPPASTWEAKS-BONESMAN.title: The Bonesman
KAPPASTWEAKS-BONESMAN.description:
A skeletal gambler who plays his bones like dominoes.
[gold]Chain[/gold] matching pips to empower your cards.
KAPPASTWEAKS-BONESMAN.goldMonologue: [sine]Enough to buy back a few of my ribs...[/sine]
KAPPASTWEAKS-BONESMAN.eventDeathPreventi: The game isn't over while I've got tiles left.
KAPPASTWEAKS-BONESMAN.aromaPrinciple: [sine][purple]Click... clack... every bone in its place...[/purple][/sine]
KAPPASTWEAKS-BONESMAN.cardsModifierDescr: Bonesman cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
KAPPASTWEAKS-BONESMAN.unlockText: Play a single run to unlock this character.
